name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.3 degrees north of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 20 times in 6 visits over 57 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 39 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.4 days starting 2026-01-30, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.29 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
